x: Going back that far reminds me of that exceptional performance in 1945 when with Burfitt (1), Main (2), Pearson (3) and Eeles (13) Belgrave 'A' won with 19 points, to be followed by Tobin (5), Clinton (7), Smart (17) and Jarlett (26) who brought home Belgrave 'B' in second place.

1938 was a quiet year for Ted but in the first few days of January 1939 he finished second in the Middlesex Cross-country championship, and the Cadogan A.C. team (consisting entirely of Belgrave runners as follows:- Stimpson 2, D. Patience 4, Shields 7, Allum 14, Tobin 15, F.R.
Tobin of Swansea was the winner in 30:14 with Brighton & Hove's P.Bristow 2nd, just 5 seconds ahead of our man. With Stu' Paton 8th in 31:11 and Jon Hobbs 12th in 31:45 the Bels took 4th team place.
